usNews.title: Singapore’s AI boom challenges the hype myth
usNews.description:
Singapore has raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 4.5%–5.5%, up sharply from the previous 2%–4% range. The upgrade offers further evidence that artificial intelligence is not merely an overhyped technology with little real-world economic impact.
